NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Insieme uses your location to centre the map and help you save the places near you.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Insieme uses the camera to take photos and videos to share in the chat.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Insieme reaches your photos so you can share them in the chat.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Insieme uses the microphone to record voice messages in the chat.
